entry.title: New: dsh-undo-savepoint
entry.summary: Undo/redo & rollback system for DSH: every config change is auto-snapshotted; undo/redo/restore to any version from the WebUI or the offline CLI/GUI tools (works even when DSH fails to boot). Exact install spec: github:lire1131/dsh-undo-savepoint. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
